03 / BEHIND THE SYSTEMS

Hi, I’m Lohith.

I’m a Platform / DevOps Engineer with an SRE background, based in Karimnagar, India. My work spans the layers that make software useful: infrastructure, delivery, storage and reliability.

From payment infrastructure at NPCI to helping build a data architecture platform for SIX Swiss Exchange through Flexilant Works, I enjoy figuring out how the pieces fit — and making them work together.

I also use Cursor, Claude and GitHub Copilot in my engineering workflow, reviewing and testing AI-assisted changes before they’re deployed.
